bull.probability_evidence: ROIC 65.3% TTM and ROCE 84.2% TTM, both still rising over 5y, operating margin 16.6% TTM near its 5y high, and TTM FCF margin (11.5%) actually above FY2025 (10.0%) despite the guidance cut; management cites modernization backlog +26% YoY and AI-driven pricing (evaluation.md Bull case; note.md §2-3, Q2 2026 transcript); low beta 0.86 and Altman Z 3.11 bound the downside if this plays out (fact sheet Other) -- tempered to 25% by the macro overlay's small bear tilt (research/OTIS/2026-10-07-macro.md).

target_band.cite: Bull basis re-rates P/E to its 5y min 22.5x (fact sheet Valuation, RA); applying the same proportional re-rating to the other two valuation anchors' own 5y mins (EV/EBITDA 16.4x, P/FCF 22.6x) on the 66.45 close (fact sheet Price, HI) gives implied prices of 87.45 / 86.49 / 101.47; half the spread (7.49) relative to the 87.0 target = 8.61%.

base.probability_evidence: All four current multiples (P/E 17.1x, EV/EBITDA 12.6x, EV/Sales 2.2x, P/FCF 14.8x) already sit below their own 5y minimums and 16-39% below the JCI/CARR/HON/LII peer median (fact sheet Valuation), so continuation of the current depressed multiple regime plus the 6.77% FCF yield funding buybacks (-2.55% shares YoY, fact sheet ST) is the modal outcome absent a re-rating catalyst or a confirmed structural margin break.

target_band.cite: Base basis holds the P/E near its current 17.1x (fact sheet RA; evaluation.md Decision JSON scenarios.base.basis) rather than re-rating toward any multiple's own 5y range; applying that same 'multiple unchanged' assumption to EV/EBITDA (12.6x) and P/FCF (14.8x) yields an identical implied price under all three anchors (no re-rating gap between them), so there is no anchor disagreement to band beyond the already-measured residual volatility.

bear.probability_evidence: Q2 2026 service operating margin fell 170bp on labour/material inflation, forcing an FY2026 operating-profit guidance cut, while net debt/EBITDA has risen to 3.04x TTM from 2.62x FY2021 and FCF conversion fell from 127.9% to 112.9% (note.md §2; fact sheet RA/CF/IS); CEO Judy Marks retires with no named successor until H1 2027 and Q3 results (Oct 28, 2026) land with momentum still negative (-27.4% 12m, fact sheet Price/News); the macro overlay adds a small bear tilt from rising real yields, a stronger dollar and wider HY spreads (research/OTIS/2026-10-07-macro.md).

target_band.cite: Bear basis holds EV/EBITDA 'near' its current 12.6x (fact sheet RA; evaluation.md Decision JSON scenarios.bear.basis) rather than further de-rating any multiple below the already-depressed current level; applying the same 'multiple unchanged, metric falls' assumption to P/E (17.1x) and P/FCF (14.8x) yields an identical implied price under all three anchors, so there is no anchor disagreement to band beyond the already-measured residual volatility.
